question: Select the most appropriate answer to fill in blank 1.
solution: The correct answer is **ability**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Ability: **the mental or physical power or skill that makes it possible to do something. (किसी कार्य को पूरा करने की मानसिक या शारीरिक शक्ति; योग्‍यता, क्षमता) • The sentence implies that tattooing is an art that requires a lot of skill. • Thus, the most appropriate answer to fill in blank 1 is **option 4**. **Correct Paragraph:**__ *Tattooing is a talent that requires a lot of time and **(1)** __**ability**__. There are many various kinds and (2) ______of tattooing. Tattooing was and still is a means to communicate someone's thoughts or life by permanently (3) _______ a design of ink and colour into their flesh. The first step in tattooing is to develop an artistic (4) _______ and the skill to sketch and create your artwork. Tattooing penmanship is far more (5) _______ than sketching on paper.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Integrity: **the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles. (ईमानदारी और दृढ़ नैतिकता, सत्‍य-निष्‍ठा) • **Capacity: **the amount that a container or space can hold. (किसी पात्र या जगह की धारणशक्ति; धारिता) • **Liability: **the state of being responsible for something. (किसी बात का उत्तरदायित्‍व) 43:Td3b, The correct answer is **genres**.
